title: Atashi Merry-san. Ima Isekai ni Iruno…….
titleRomaji: Atashi Merry-san. Ima Isekai ni Iruno…….
titleNative: あたしメリーさん。いま異世界にいるの……。
synonyms: It's Mary-san. I'm in another world now...
synopsis: Naibara Hirokazu left his parent's home in Miyagi to attend university in Tokyo and began living alone in an apartment in Saitama. Soon after moving, he answers a phone call from an unknown number that rings repeatedly, and hears a girl's voice saying "I'm Mary, I'm at the garbage dump right now... I'm the doll you threw away..." Thinking it's a prank call, he hangs up, but the call comes again and again... It seems like the girl is calling little by little, moving towards him!? The next day, he answers the phone, not knowing how many times it has already been called, and hears "I'm Mary, I'm in front of your room right now..." No sooner does he hear a strange voice praying from outside the apartment...? A phone call from Saitama to give advice to Mary, the urban legend who has been transported to another world!? A little girl connected by smartphone to a university student's story of defeating the demon king!! (Source: Gamma Plus, translated)

synopsis: Kutsuzawa Yasuo is a gloomy loner with zero friends. As he walks home alone like always, he has a chance encounter with the class’s top-tier beauty a popular gyaru admired by everyone! After helping her when she nearly falls and fixing her bicycle, he plans to quietly leave... but she looks at him with sparkling eyes instead. A gloomy introvert and a cheerful extrovert who were never supposed to cross paths yet somehow, they begin to grow closer. Thus begins an awkward but heartwarming youthful romantic comedy between two opposites.

synopsis: One day Kaoru Aoyama is working as a normal office worker in Japan and the next she's waking up to find that she's become Patience Granger, the daughter of a viscount! She isn't sure if she's been reincarnated into this world or if she's just possessing this body, but one thing is for sure: This isn't a simple magical adventure in another world. Despite being nobles, the Granger family is destitute! Patience is desperate to figure out how to help her family, including her adorable younger brothers, but her magic proficiency lies in household magic—a type relating to domestic chores. Not only does she have her family to worry about but Patience is also ten years old. She'll be enrolling in the Royal Academy, where she'll have to navigate relationships with other nobles while trying to grow her skills. Using her knowledge from her past life and the memories she has from the original Patience, this young noble is determined to use her talents to protect her angelic little brothers! (Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis: By some ill fortune, Hikaru died in a traffic accident. He was in heaven standing in line, waiting to be judged, when he took an unexpected request to transfer his soul into a person in another world. He received an ability called Soul Board which he could use to allocate points to Skills to make himself more powerful. But there was a catch… "I want you to take revenge on someone for me within an hour. If you don’t, I’ll destroy your soul." To pull off the task assigned to him, he poured all his available points to the Stealth skill tree. This is a story of a boy who specialised in Stealth. With his skill trees as weapons, he would demonstrate his unrivalled strength in another world.

synopsis: Tsuyoshi Kawabata is just a regular convenience store employee in a mid-sized city west of Tokyo. Except... he also happens to be the most powerful fighter in the world. Although he doesn't particularly want to fight, his reputation precedes him, and martial artists come from all over the world to test their might against the mythical Tsuyoshi – and invariably end up handily beaten, clutching their battered family jewels in a convenience store parking lot. Should you wish to fight him, he has three rules to minimize inconvenience: 1) You only get one fight. There will be no rematch. 2) You will fight in a secluded area, where you won't be seen. 3) You will tell nobody about it – even if you lose.
